headers.comment: The HTML shell must revalidate: the default max-age=3600 left returning users on a cached shell pointing at a hashed bundle the new deploy no longer serves — a blank page for up to an hour. Matches '**' because every route rewrites to index.html, so '/index.html' alone never matches a request for '/' or '/routines'. The /assets/** rule below is listed later and so wins for hashed files.
Asset filenames are content-hashed by vite, so they can be cached forever.
